newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3920/3.3937 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3920/3.3937 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3905 to 3.3940 bid and 3.3920 to 3.3970 offer in the interbank market on Sunday.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3920 pounds bid and 3.3937 offered. The averages compared to 3.3918 pounds bid and 3.3941 offered on Thursday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday (1000 GMT) as 3.390006 buy and 3.398016 sell.
